title: Quality Manager: Top Gaps
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Show me the top care gaps and which ones are most actionable.

answer.question: Show me the top care gaps and which ones are most actionable.
answer.answer:
Here's the lineup (all synthetic data, pending clinical/quality review):

| Measure | Patients | Revenue Risk | Reachable |
|---|---|---|---|
| Diabetes A1C test | 387 | $189,450 | 76% |
| Breast cancer screen | 243 | $94,170 | 89% |
| Colorectal screen | 198 | $76,890 | 62% |
| Statin therapy | 176 | $43,120 | 91% |
| Blood pressure control | 138 | $25,270 | 84% |

**Most actionable:**
- **Diabetes A1C test** — biggest prize: 387 patients, $189K at stake, good reachability. Top priority.
- **Statin therapy** — 91% reachable, easiest to close even though smaller dollar value.
- **Breast cancer screen** — strong combo of size, revenue ($94K), and 89% reachability.
- **Colorectal screen** — lowest reachability (62%), so harder to move even with real dollars on the line.

Want me to dig into the diabetes cohort risk breakdown or draft an outreach strategy for one of these?
